ledger.contains: Spreadsheet of all valid third-country residence permits on 31.12.2016: a data sheet (one row per issuing office, nationality, EU category, permit type, sex and age band, with a count) and pivot sheets by EU category x nationality x sex, permit type x sex and EU category x age. Golden-visa permits identified by category 'ΜΟΝΙΜΗ ΑΔΕΙΑ ΔΙΑΜΟΝΗΣ ΕΠΕΝΔΥΤΗ (Ν4251/14)' (art. 20 Law 4251/2014) plus the older 'ΙΔΙΟΚΤΗΤΕΣ ΑΚΙΝΗΤΩΝ άρθρο 36Α του Ν.3386/05' (owners) and 'ΜΕΛΗ ΟΙΚΟΓΕΝΕΙΑΣ - άρθρο 36Α του Ν.3386/05' (their family members), column ΚΑΤΗΓΟΡΙΑ. Extracted: golden-visa permits by nationality, by issuing office and by age band (sums of the data-sheet rows, each adding up to the pivot total), plus the small separate investor category ('ΕΠΕΝΔΥΤΕΣ'/'ΕΠΕΝΔΥΤΗΣ', not the golden visa) from the pivot sheet. Sex splits not taken (nationality available). Family members of art. 20 investors are not identifiable (they fall under the general family-reunification category); only the art. 36A family category is. All other permit categories are out of scope.
